Reacher, Euka, and Cruva are three of the strongest TikTok Shop affiliate platforms, and they are more alike than different: each gives you a large creator database, automated outreach, sampling, and reporting for roughly $159 to $599 a month. Reacher leans into AI outreach, Euka into an all-in-one lifecycle, and Cruva into an AI "operating system" with a creator community. The honest catch for all three: they are software you operate, so they only pay off if you have someone to run them.

Reacher

  • Focus: AI-driven outreach across DM, Target Collab, and email, with a CRM and an AI agent on higher tiers.
  • Database: 3M+ creators.
  • Pricing: ~$199 to $599/mo.
  • Best for: teams that want strong outreach automation and a clean CRM.

Euka

  • Focus: all-in-one lifecycle, discovery through payout, plus an AI store copilot.
  • Database: 3.5 to 4M+ creators.
  • Pricing: ~$159 to $479/mo.
  • Best for: brands wanting the whole workflow under one login. Note its headline proof is platform-wide GMV, not your GMV.

Cruva

  • Focus: an AI "operating system" with segmentation, AI sample approval, content tracking, and a creator community.
  • Pricing: ~$199 to $599/mo (+ enterprise).
  • Best for: teams that value segmentation and the community features.

Side by side

Reacher Euka Cruva
Focus AI outreach All-in-one lifecycle AI operating system
Database 3M+ 3.5 to 4M+ Large
Pricing ~$199 to $599 ~$159 to $479 ~$199 to $599
Standout CRM + AI agent Payout to discovery in one Community + segmentation

Prices and database sizes drift, so verify each vendor's current pricing before deciding. Our fuller roundup is best TikTok Shop affiliate software.

How to choose between them

  • Want the cleanest outreach and CRM: Reacher.
  • Want everything in one login: Euka.
  • Want segmentation and a creator community: Cruva.

Honestly, for most brands the differences matter less than the shared requirement: all three need an operator with the time and skill to run them daily.

The bigger risk all three share

More than any feature gap, the shared risk is optimizing for reach over relationships. A founder whose brand is on track for $35 million on TikTok Shop this year warned that brands that "blast out thousands of affiliate DMs, hope something sticks" simply "wonder why growth plateaus," and that the fix is to "go deep on affiliate relationships, not wide" (@brock_mammoser on X). All three tools make it easy to go wide. Going deep is a decision the operator makes, not the software.

When none of them is the answer

If you do not have that operator, the most powerful of these tools still drives $0, because nobody is running it. That is the case for a managed agency: the software is similar, but the judgment and daily execution come with it. See DIY, software, or agency.

The takeaway

Reacher, Euka, and Cruva are all capable, and your choice among them is a detail next to the bigger question: do you have someone to operate the tool? If yes, pick on the standout that fits your team. If no, a managed program will out-perform any of them.

Not sure you have the capacity to run software? Book a call, or try the creator finder first.
